description: This file defines the Shipping class within the Opencart extension system. It calculates shipping costs and related taxes during the total calculation process in an OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Handles the calculation of shipping costs and applicable taxes, updating totals and taxes during the checkout process.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adds shipping costs to the total, updating taxes if applicable.
